responsibility: Coordinates monomorphization partitioning queries for the local crate. It collects mono items, partitions them into codegen units using the module’s partitioner, checks that produced symbols are distinct, exposes the resulting CGU and codegened-item query providers, and derives the set of items that were codegened or appeared through MIR inlining.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the partitioning submodule under monomorphization, specifically responsible for collecting local mono items into codegen units and exposing related queries. Unlike `monomorphize/mod.rs`, it is not the umbrella module for monomorphization support in general.
